customManagers.description: Container images in Helm values given as a single string, marked with a '# renovate: datasource=docker' comment

packageRules.description: Pin container images by digest, so image rebuilds (e.g. OS security fixes in the base image) show up as updates.
Automerge base image rebuilds. Each merge rebuilds and redeploys the site, which also picks up the 'dnf upgrade' in the Dockerfile.
MariaDB: LTS series only. From 12.3 onwards every .3 release is LTS; 11.8 is the last LTS from before that rule and can be removed once we're on 12.3.
Automerge patch releases and image rebuilds within a MariaDB series. In production each merge restarts the database briefly. Moving to a new series is a major update and is never automerged.

WordPress isn't semver: x.y is a feature release, x.y.z a maintenance/security release. composer.json allows only maintenance releases (~7.1.4), so lockfile maintenance never moves to a new feature release. Maintenance releases get their own lockfile-only PR; a feature release (e.g. 7.2) gets a PR that also updates the constraint.
Theme dependencies: group minor and patch updates into one PR (as Dependabot's 'regular-updates' group did).
